status: Validated material/fossil reuse; PR and actual merged proof follow. Final uncontended timing acceptance remains deferred.
changes: Keep layered GPU material mask and output storage exclusive through count/emit; retain up to 32 exact runs per column and replay overflow/invalid encodings using the original evaluator. Reuse completed buffers in pools capped at two.
Reuse covered fossil quart biomes, preserving sparse fallback and empty-batch validation.

Use immutable target masks, uniform blob edit/overlay bitsets, ground transitions and selected height queries directly from material runs. Preserve exact ordered fallback for unsupported geometry, collisions and limited within-root prefixes.
Pack command indices without changing original command order; visit ore coordinates with exact ascending first-visit bitsets. No root scheduling or scalar point shortcut included.

validation.comparison: Every counted instance matches both immutable original and actual preceding merged main; full decompressed NBT and membership. Only MCA timestamps and compression representation excluded. Repeated coordinates are not unique coverage.
validation.matrix: Five representative profiles, five warmups and twenty measured complete regions each; 1/2/4/8 requests distinct from 16 assembly workers; reverse order; GPU lighting, zlib, observed shader status 4. Additional tall 384-block case, Overworld ABBA repeats, 314-region retention and five actual loader/native/client fixture groups.
validation.runtime_native_mapping: All three client fixture processes mapped the retained candidate library by observed path and SHA-256.
validation.source_and_process_freeze: Initial, repeat and extended controllers actually exited 0; all observed PIDs were absent in terminal receipts before source edits.

overworld_repeat.scope: Two normal fresh-process repetitions per library and request count in ABBA order. Pooled40region distributions and combined throughput are descriptive; per-run results are retained. Same coordinates are repeated evidence, not new corpus coverage. No uncontended timing acceptance.

limitations: Joined ownership and named buffer capacities are bounded for these fixed profiles and request orders; they are not whole-process current RSS or indefinite memory proof.
VM footprint is a separate actual process observation; do not sum it with logical buffer/cache bytes.
Test-only collectors and VM checkpoints make this unsuitable as headline timing.
No causal process-memory comparison with main was performed in this census.

interpretation: Standard Nether instructions fall 17.9–20.0% across observed request counts; custom profiles fall 9.2–11.5%. Serial anchor/column/prefix/request counts remain unchanged. Standard view-column loads fall 19.9–20.8%, version archive payload about 19%; these are work/byte counts, not wall shares.

Main-seed isolated p95 remains 1.482 s in the initial host-contended window; this is not subsecond acceptance. Concurrent throughput improved in these runs, but several tail observations regress and all values remain retained.

Initial serial Overworld total elapsed rises 93.2%, CPU 25.0%, instructions 0.35%. Assembly grows 137.5→373.4 ms while GPU falls 94.2→88.7 ms. That large slowdown does not recur in two fresh-process repeats. Pooled repeated serial throughput +9.15%, CPU −0.83%; eight-request throughput −3.15%, p95 +2.98%, CPU +1.05%, instructions +0.34%. This is not an uncontended no-regression claim.

Named GPU capacity grows between first/second serial rounds then matches exactly in second/third. Fixed profiles, request order and test instrumentation limit this census; VM footprint is separate from logical capacities.
Client fixtures use integrated creative QA with placement helpers, not unaided survival or dedicated-server acceptance. Portal and tick timings remain provisional.

recovery.instructions: Use new evidence output directories and the recorded source revision. Retained scripts record full commands and library/profile/support hashes. Do not overwrite existing proofs. Reference corpora and all worktrees remain preserved.
recovery.compression: Only completed owned experiment worlds were transparently APFS-compressed. Full-file SHA-256 before/after equality and restoration commands are retained in compression receipts; file bytes and paths are unchanged.
